question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) had ________ that the city would witness rainfall on Thursday.
solution:
```html
The correct answer is '**forecast**'.

• The word "**forecast**" means to predict or estimate future events, especially weather conditions. (पूर्वानुमान)
 
• The Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) provides predictions or forecasts about weather conditions.
